findings.claim: The round-2 integrated slutsvep asserts an exhaustiveness it does not have: "Den enda faktiska lexikala bryggan mellan bladen går mellan hushållet (q1 C) och hushållen (q2 A)". There are at least two further lexical bridges between the two option sheets, one of them a shared verb frame, not a bare token echo. The stage's CONCLUSION survives intact (every bridge is distractor-to-distractor and points away from both keys), but the sentence as written is false and it is the sentence a later audit will inherit as settled.
findings.evidence: Tokenised both option sets of candidates-final/las-b15-003.json. (1) Substring bridge missed: q1 C "Att firandet höll sig inom hushållet." vs q2 A "Namnsdagsfirandet upphörde helt och hållet i samma stund ..." — firandet is contained in Namnsdagsfirandet; q2 D also carries "Att fira namnsdag". (2) Lemma + preposition frame missed: q1 C "höll sig inom hushållet" vs q2 C "hålla namnsdagsuppvaktningen inom den egna familjen och den närmaste släkten" — same lemma hålla plus the shared preposition inom (inom is the only content-ish token the tokeniser shows shared outside the named pair). This makes q1 C and q2 C near-twin claims ("celebration confined to the household" / "advice was to keep it inside the family"), which is the semantic parallel the round-2 self_blind_solve originally named and the slutsvep then dismissed as "en semantisk parallell, inte ett ordupprepande" — it is in fact both.
findings.why: The slutsvep re-opened this exact sentence to correct the generator and got the census wrong in the other direction, so the record now carries a confident false negative where the OMLÖSNING carried a merely imprecise one. The twin q1 C / q2 C claim also gives a mild cross-question elimination (a student who rejects one rejects the other) on a sheet that is already carrying a G-STEM major on q2 — worth naming in the adjudication package rather than leaving as "the only bridge, and it is harmless".

findings.claim: generator_meta.originality_note still ships a false real-entity result: "'Barbro Malmryd' svensk person författare' → ingen bärare av efternamnet Malmryd". Malmryd is a real, currently-borne Swedish surname and the same tool the generator used returns bearers on the first page. This was already raised at minor severity in audits-round1/las-b15-003.json and was NOT corrected in repair round 2, even though round 2 did open generator_meta twice for metadata-only notes.
findings.evidence: Exa (mcp__claude_ai_Exa__web_search_exa), this session, query 'category:people svensk person med efternamnet Malmryd', first page: Oskar Malmryd (linkedin.com/in/oskar-malmryd-01607584, Product Owner Vehicle Operations, Lynk & Co, Gothenburg SE); Gösta Malmryd (linkedin.com/in/gösta-malmryd-26908468, Planerings- och utvecklingschef, Idrotts- och föreningsförvaltningen, Göteborgs Stad); Annika Malmryd (linkedin.com/in/annika-malmryd-36586048, Enhetschef på Språkcentrum i Göteborg). The uncorrected note is in candidates-final/las-b15-003.json, generator_meta.originality_note, item (5). The parallel Rimhall sentence ("ingen bärare av namnet Rimhall i något resultat") also stands uncorrected; my own query 'person med efternamnet Rimhall' returned only near-misses (Brimhall, Rimvall, Rhallab), consistent with no Swedish bearer.
findings.why: Law 16 is NOT breached and the item is safe to ship: no essayist, author or ethnologist named Malmryd or Rimhall, and no bearer of the full names Barbro Malmryd or Algot Rimhall. The defect is in the ledger, not the passage. But ASSEMBLY.md flag 1 explicitly hands degraded name verification forward to V-FINAL, and a flat 'no bearer of the surname' is precisely the sentence that would let V-FINAL close the check without re-running it. The correct shape is the batch14 form: surname-exists / full-name-clear.

findings.claim: repair_log round 2 edits[] is incomplete. It lists three edits (q2 option B text, q2 rationale, generator_meta.self_blind_solve) but the q1 rationale was also changed in round 2 and is not in the array. The only trace is a [PROVENIENS ... runda 2] bracket buried inside self_blind_solve — the field whose own edit entry says the change was "tillagt, aldrig överskrivet", i.e. the log documents its own bookkeeping but not the student-facing text it also touched.
findings.evidence: diff candidates-final-round1/las-b15-003.json vs candidates-final/las-b15-003.json, questions[q_index=1].rationale: "A är reversed_causality och är den enda distraktor som texten uttryckligen tar upp och vänder på" → "A är reversed_causality och är den läsning som texten uttryckligen tillskriver andra och sedan vänder på". repair_log[0].edits[*].where = ['questions[q_index=2].options[B].text', 'questions[q_index=2].rationale (nyckelmotiveringen, distraktormotiveringarna orörda)', 'generator_meta.self_blind_solve'] — no q_index=1 entry. The self_blind_solve bracket that does record it ends "Ingen nyckel, stam eller alternativtext rörd", which is true but is not the same statement as 'no other rationale was rewritten'.
findings.why: The edit itself is an improvement and I verified it is correct on the merits (the removed exclusivity claim was self-contradicted three sentences later by "C ... vänder dessutom stycke 3"). The finding is provenance only: repair_log is the machine-readable diff of record, and a rationale rewrite that appears only in free prose inside another field cannot be reconciled mechanically. Round 1's corrections (passage "i hörnet" → "på hörnet", q1 rationale) are likewise absent from repair_log, so this is a repeatable gap, not a one-off slip.

findings.claim: Two planted_traps labels still do not name the actual trap after round 2: q1/C is filed scope_shift and q2/C detail_as_main, but q1/C is a flat reversal of the passage and q2/C is a misattribution to a quoted source. Raised in audits-round1 and uncorrected, despite round 2 having opened generator_meta for two other metadata notes.
findings.evidence: generator_meta.planted_traps: {"1": {"C": "scope_shift"}, "2": {"C": "detail_as_main"}}. q1 C = "Att firandet höll sig inom hushållet." against passage ¶3 "Därför kunde uppvaktningen sträcka sig långt utanför den närmaste kretsen." — reversal, not narrowing. q2 C = "Etikettbokens viktigaste råd var att hålla namnsdagsuppvaktningen inom den egna familjen och den närmaste släkten." while the book's only quoted words are "en gåva på namnsdagen bör inte överstiga vad mottagaren utan besvär kan ge igen" — the option invents advice the source never gives, which is misattribution, not a real detail promoted to main point. Both rationales concede the hybrid in their own words: "C är scope_shift och vänder dessutom stycke 3" and "C är detail_as_main med en förvrängning".
findings.why: The items are unaffected — both options are correctly unkeyable and the student-facing rationales describe them accurately, which is why this is not a refutation of the pedagogy verdict. It is a taxonomy-census defect: planted_traps is the machine-readable field any later 'which misconception does this distractor teach' mining reads, and a contradiction filed as scope_shift skews it silently.

findings.claim: The language stage recorded CLEAR with a live, undisposed G-SPRAK minor on the page. I agree with CLEAR on the merits — I re-read the passage for calque, agreement, register and spelling-variety and found nothing convictable — but the record shows the stage never dispositioned the one language finding the gate did raise.
findings.evidence: verdicts.jsonl, las-b15-003, G-SPRAK vote 1: verdict "flag", severity minor, quote "bör inte överstiga vad mottagaren utan besvär kan ge igen", note "class 6: 'ge igen' in modern Swedish overwhelmingly reads as 'retaliate / get even' ... Native alternative: 'kan gengälda' or 'kan ge tillbaka'." Votes 2 and 3 pass. reviews/language.jsonl carries only {"verdict":"CLEAR"} with no findings and no reference to the flag. My own reading: 'ge igen' in the sense återgälda is attested and the framing "I en etikettbok från 1934 sägs det rent ut" carries the older reciprocation reading, so the flag is taste-level, as its own note concedes. Everything else checks clean: agreement ("ett skevt material", "allmän egendom", "namnsdagen billig" utrum), the relative gap in "människor man inte stod nära men gärna ville visa uppmärksamhet" (same gap serves stå ngn nära and visa ngn uppmärksamhet), idiom ("handlaren på hörnet", "gå varsamt fram", "riktningen är han säker på"), typography (only ”…”, only spaced en dash, zero em dashes).
findings.why: Recorded for record hygiene, not as a challenge to CLEAR. The audits-round1 finding on the same passage ('inte' vs period 'icke' in the 1934 quotation) is likewise still open; between the two, the one quoted historical voice in the unit has had two language observations raised and none dispositioned. No key, distractor or rationale depends on the quote's wording, so any fix here is free.
